Install superwhisper on Omarchy

Local and cloud voice dictation with Superwhisper

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add superwhisper-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.0.2-1:
    pacman -Qi superwhisper-bin

Open and use superwhisper

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql superwhisper-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install superwhisper on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add superwhisper-bin. The download is 52.8 MB and it takes 188.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is superwhisper free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed LicenseRef-proprietary, MIT.

How do I uninstall superwhisper?

Run omarchy pkg drop superwhisper-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does superwhisper depend on?

The package declares 20 dependencies: glibc, libgcc, libstdc++, libgomp, xdg-utils, python, python-gobject, python-cairo, gtk4, gtk4-layer-shell, at-spi2-core, pipewire-pulse and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is superwhisper in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as superwhisper-bin (version 1.0.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://superwhisper.com. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
